name: peallaidh
text: peallaidh names a regional Scottish Gaelic water-haunting spirit related to the ùruisg. The form is especially tied to the town of Aberfeldy, thirty-two miles northwest of Perth. The town borrows its name from this creature. Although not a water-spirit proper, the peallaidh was said to haunt rivers, lochs, and the seashore. The wider family of such figures also includes the fuath, and the tradition sits within Highland folklore.

attributes.attribute: Scottish Gaelic water-haunting spirit associated with Aberfeldy

okr.objective: peallaidh is the MacKillop headword for the Aberfeldy water-haunting spirit.
